subject: Latency spike on Mar 31 — compensation & trial extension request
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@edgescale.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@edgescale.com>
Date: 2028-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Significant latency + dropped requests (Mar 31) — ask for remediation

Hi Marissa,

We had a bad production window last night (Mar 31, 21:40–22:30 PST) where p95/p99 for generate calls shot up and a non-trivial number of requests returned 502s. That resulted in ~12% of our nightly batch jobs failing and retries causing cascading costs for our team.

Can you confirm what happened and whether EdgeScale is eligible for a credit or trial extension? We’re in month two of the trial and that disruption materially impacted our evaluation.

Attaching a short list of failed request IDs and spans. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of ML Platform — EdgeScale
attachments: failed_requests_20280331.csv (csv), span_snippets.txt (txt)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@edgescale.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Significant latency + dropped requests (Mar 31) — ask for remediation

Hi Elena — thank you for the alert and the artifacts. I’m really sorry this happened during your trial. We see the same spike in our telemetry and are pulling the detailed p95/p99 traces now. Initial note: there was a model rollout overlap + autoscaler edge case that led to temporary KV cache thrashing for a subset of requests.

Immediate next steps:
- I’ll escalate to infra and get the postmortem artifacts to you by tomorrow EOD (Apr 2).
- As a short-term goodwill gesture I can issue an immediate token credit and a 30-day trial extension while we finish the RCA and remediation plan.

Before I finalize the amount with finance, can you confirm the best way to accept the credit (HubSpot invoice record or direct account credit)? Also confirm whether you want the trial extension on the current org or a new sandbox org.

If it helps I can set up a 30-minute call today to walk through what we saw.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-04-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: EdgeScale incident — proposed make-good (please review)

Team — forwarding Elena’s note and telemetry. Key facts: 21:40–22:30 PST, p99 latency up by ~3–5x for generation endpoints, 502s on about 12% of batch requests; cause appears to be model rollout overlap + autoscaler race that caused KV cache misses & cold paths.

Proposed make-good (draft):
- Immediate: $5,000 token credit applied to EdgeScale account (covers retry costs)
- Trial: 30-day trial extension on their existing org
- Promotional: 25% off next paid month if they convert within 60 days
- Deliverable: full RCA + remediation plan by EOD Apr 2 (Monica to own)

Ask: Karthik — can you sign off on the $5k? Ben — confirm this does not require special finance approval (below the $10k threshold). Monica — can you lead RCA & attach logs to a shared doc?

Thanks,
Marissa
